name: Reed
author: Erin Carter
description: A palisade of upright glowing tubes filling the frame edge to edge, like an LED light strip stood on end or an equalizer at rest. Each reed carries its own palette hue and a bright pulse of charge rises continuously up its length over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Reed spacing
params.effect: Spacing between the tubes in CSS pixels - a dense fence of fine reeds at the minimum, a few broad columns at the maximum.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing reed in CSS pixels, from a hairline filament to a fat neon rod.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge rising up the reeds; 0 freezes the light as static beads, high sends it racing skyward.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each reed; low is a crisp drawn line, high a luminous bloom that floods the gaps with colour.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Tilts the whole palisade; 0 stands the reeds upright, 90 lays them flat as horizontal rails, anything between leans them on a diagonal.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Reshuffles which hue each reed takes and re-rolls the random lean and depth of every reed, for a fresh arrangement.

params.label: Angle scatter
params.effect: Randomizes each reed's lean independently; 0 keeps the palisade perfectly parallel, higher lets the reeds tilt every which way like windblown grass.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: Spreads the reeds across depth; 0 holds them all on one plane, higher makes some reeds read as near (bright and fat) and others far (dim and thin) for a layered field.
